stories.title: Genesee County delays vote on data center environmental clearance
stories.dek: The economic development corporation postponed a key environmental approval for a proposed data center. Flint-area residents now face more uncertainty over traffic, power needs, and industrial noise from the project. The delay gives the public extra weeks to review impacts before any final decision.
stories.source_title: GCEDC appears to delay environmental approval vote for data center - TheDailyNewsOnline.com

stories.title: Otsego bans new data centers for a year
stories.dek: Otsego city council voted to halt all data center proposals for 12 months. Residents near potential sites now have breathing room before any large power or water demands hit local infrastructure. The pause gives the community time to shape rules that protect neighborhoods from noise and grid strain.
stories.source_title: Otsego Council passes 1-year data centers moratorium - hometownsource.com

stories.title: Mason County bids to host Michigan's official state data center
stories.dek: Local leaders are pitching the county as the site for a major state-backed facility that could bring construction jobs and long-term tax revenue. Residents would also face questions about power demand and land use if the project advances. The effort puts a rural western Michigan county in competition with larger metro areas for the economic prize.
stories.source_title: When Mason County pursued Michigan's state data center - shorelinemedia.net

stories.title: Coldwater residents get first look at data center plans at joint meeting
stories.dek: Coldwater City Council and planners will brief the public on proposed data centers. Residents want to know how much power and water the projects would pull and what tax breaks are on the table. The session comes as similar fights heat up in nearby townships.
stories.source_title: Coldwater City Council and Planning Commission to hold joint data center informational meeting - WTVB

stories.title: Verrus pushes ahead on Michigan data center while Salem site stalls
stories.dek: Verrus is moving forward with a Michigan project even as its Salem plans remain uncertain. The company has not disclosed the exact site or size, but local officials are already fielding questions about power demand and tax deals. Michigan communities are watching to see which town lands the next big facility.
stories.source_title: While Salem project is uncertain, Verrus advances data center in Michigan - Salem Reporter

stories.title: El-Sayed rallies at Saline data center site to blast AI power deals
stories.dek: The Senate candidate used the Saline project as a backdrop to attack tax breaks and grid strain from hyperscale builds. Residents 30 minutes away face higher electric rates if the campus pulls hundreds of megawatts without new generation. The stop highlights how local projects are now central to the Democratic primary debate.
stories.source_title: ICYMI: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed Joins Press Conference at “The Barn” Data Center in Saline - Abdul for U.S. Senate

stories.title: Dowagiac data center noise torments nearby homes day and night
stories.dek: Neighbors describe a constant high-pitched whine from the facility that runs around the clock. The complaints are now shaping how Cass County will handle future proposals. Residents want rules that protect sleep and property values before more projects arrive.
stories.source_title: A Dowagiac Data Center Runs 24/7 And Neighbors Say It Screams Like A Demon - Mix 95.7

stories.title: Congressman calls for review of Chinese robots at Michigan data center site
stories.dek: A U.S. representative wants Commerce to examine Hyperscale Data's use of foreign equipment on its Michigan campus. The move raises questions about supply-chain security and local construction jobs. Residents near the project could see delays or new federal scrutiny.
stories.source_title: US Congressman Seeks Commerce Review of Hyperscale Data's Use of Chinese Robots in Michigan Project - AI Insider

stories.title: Saline data center seeks river discharge permit amid local pushback
stories.dek: A permit application for discharging into the Saline River is now open for public comment, tied to a major data center project. Residents in Washtenaw County face potential impacts on local water quality and usage from the facility's operations. The filing highlights ongoing tensions over infrastructure demands in the township.
stories.source_title: Weekly Data Center Watch: Saline River Discharge Permit Opens for Comment - The Sun Times News

stories.title: District C race hinges on pausing AI server farms until power, zoning rules catch up
stories.dek: The two contenders for District C on the county council say local rules are not ready for large AI projects. They want a pause while the county studies power demand and zoning. The race could set the tone for other southwest Michigan townships.
stories.source_title: Both candidates for St. Joseph County Council District C call for data center moratorium - WNDU

stories.title: El-Sayed slams Saline data center plan over power and water costs
stories.dek: Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed used a C-SPAN appearance to criticize the Oracle-OpenAI project in Saline, citing its expected draw on the electric grid and local water supplies. He argued the tax breaks and infrastructure strain would fall on Michigan residents while benefits flow elsewhere. The remarks sharpen the debate ahead of the August primary.
stories.source_title: Candidate Abdul El-Sayed (D-MI) Remarks on Data Center in Saline, MI - C-SPAN

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.

meetings.topic: Data Center Subcommittee Update and zoning ordinance discussion
